name: Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Projected Maximum Positive Degree
details: The maximum-positive-degree lower bound for positive no-clashing teaching applies to every coordinate trace.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{d}^{+}_{\max}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize both sides over S.
